infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: EZRA uses the microphone so you can speak to your personal assistant.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: EZRA converts your speech into text so you can send messages by voice.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow EZRA to use your microphone for voice messages.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow EZRA to convert your speech into text.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow EZRA to access photos you choose to attach.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow EZRA to take photos you choose to attach.
